about.description: Netflish is a passion project by Ish, forked from movie-web. Hosted privately on netfl.ishkumar.com, Netflish offers ad-free streaming because Ish believes media should be free (and ridiculously fun!).

q1.body: Netflish, an Ish special, doesn't host content. Click to watch, and we scour the web for your media (check loading/sources tab for origins). Ish's Netflish uploads nothing; it's all magic searching.
q1.title: Where does the content come from?

q2.body: Can't request media directly, sorry! Ish's Netflish doesn't manage content; it's all sourced from the wild web.
q2.title: Where can I request a show or movie?

q3.body: Search results are powered by TMDB. They show up even if Ish's sources haven't snagged the content yet. Patience, young padawan.
q3.title: The search results display the show or movie, why can't I play it?

q4.body: Your data syncs to the community backend. Feel free to use it – Ish encourages sharing (the good kind).
q4.title: What about my data and stuff?

q5.body: Netflish has a Discord server, probably conjured by Ish. Find the link in the header!
q5.title: How can I find out more?
